_example._exampleNote: Placeholder example. Every prose field must be written from verified sources by a researcher; summaries citing a tafsir/hadith must match the linked documents' citations.

_note: VERIFICATION POLICY: a research note may be seeded, but it must stay status "draft" with confidence "low" until a reviewer has checked every claim against the cited sources. Publish gate (enforced in the admin review UI): at least one Sunni source, at least one Shia source, at least two independent references, exact volume/page citations. Rows with placeholder "…" prose or an unresolvable verse are rejected by scripts/seed-sample-research.ts.

comparison.agreements: what both schools agree on (array of strings)
comparison.differences: where they differ, stated neutrally (array of strings)

_schema.confidence: high | medium | low (required; seed as "low" unless reviewed)
_schema.language: language of the prose, e.g. bengali (optional, default bengali)
_schema.references: array of embedded references: { type: tafsir|hadith|book|article|dictionary|manuscript, title (required), author, volume, page, publisher, publicationYear, url, citationFormat, notes }

shiaView.summary: Shia view summary, written from the linked/cited sources (optional)

_schema.status: draft | review | published — always seed as "draft" (optional, default draft)

sunniView.summary: Sunni view summary, written from the linked/cited sources (optional)

_schema.title: note title (required)
_schema.verse: { surahNumber, ayahNumber } convenience lookup — resolved to the Verse _id at seed time (required unless verseId is given)
_schema.verseId: Verse document _id as a string (alternative to "verse")
